name: cockpit
description: Live gauges around the prompt: model, 7d and 5h limits, prompts and requests, main and subagent costs, the prompt cache's time left, and the project's git and pull request state; plus /cockpit:handoff, which writes a handoff document before the cache goes cold.

layout.title: Cockpit: Layout
layout.description: The lines around the prompt, top to bottom, split by ;. A line is prompt, spacer for a blank line, fresh or compact for an offer line while its own option is on, explain for the explanation line while explain_row is on, which holds the run-out warning while limit_forecast is on, or a row. Lines before prompt draw above your prompt, lines after it under it. A row is a comma list of tags, left to right, from folders, branch, worktree, pr, review, comments, sync, conflict, checks, changes, model, limit_7d, limit_5h, context, turns, tokens, agents, cache, with spacer and gap-1, gap-2 or gap-3 between them. Any tag can go in any row. The tags after a hidden line are switched off. A tag left out goes after the one before it in the default order, an unknown name is ignored. Set by dragging in /cockpit:order. (default: the git row above the prompt, the status row, the offers and the explanation line under it)

merge_costs.title: Cockpit: Costs › merge
merge_costs.description: One Σ tag for the main conversation and its subagents together, instead of a tag each. Hovered, it shows their tokens added up. true / false (default)

gradients.title: Cockpit: Colours › gradients
gradients.description: Text and bars blend from one colour to the next, and the model's name sweeps. Off, each draws in one colour, the first of its gradient, and the context bar in its three colours as bands. Set in /cockpit:colors. true (default) / false

colors.title: Cockpit: Colours
colors.description: Your colours, as a comma list of name=#rrggbb, such as turns.from=#60a5fa,pr.open=#facc15. A name left out keeps its default, an unknown one or a colour that does not read is ignored. Set by typing in /cockpit:colors. (default: none)

auto_handoff.title: Cockpit: Hand off before the cache goes cold
auto_handoff.description: Runs /cockpit:handoff once while the session is idle, a few minutes before the prompt cache expires, and writes HANDOFF-<date-time>.md at the project's root. It runs again only after your next prompt. true (default) / false

keep_warm_pings.title: Cockpit: Keep the cache warm (pings)
keep_warm_pings.description: How many minimal prompts the mod sends while the session is idle, each just before the prompt cache expires, to keep it warm; the handoff runs after the last one, on a 5-minute cache too. About 25 pings cost as much as writing a 5-minute cache once, and a fresh session from the handoff is usually cheaper and answers faster, so keep this low. (default: 0)

fresh_start.title: Cockpit: Offer a fresh start from the handoff
fresh_start.description: Once this session wrote a handoff, a line under the prompt offers a fresh session from it, with a button that starts it. With the cache cold it also shows what the next message costs here; with it warm, the line hides on your next message. true (default) / false

auto_compact.title: Cockpit: Compact when the smart zone is nearly used
auto_compact.description: Runs /compact once while the session is idle, as soon as the context has used 90% of the smart zone. It runs again only after your next prompt. true / false (default)

compact_hint.title: Cockpit: Offer a compaction when the smart zone is nearly used
compact_hint.description: Once the context has used 90% of the smart zone, a line under the prompt offers to compact the session, with a button that does. true (default) / false

dismiss_minutes.title: Cockpit: Dismissed offers stay hidden (minutes)
dismiss_minutes.description: How long the cross on the fresh-start and compaction lines hides its line. 0 hides it for the rest of the session. (default: 0)

limit_style.title: Cockpit: Limit tags › style
limit_style.description: How the 7d and 5h tags draw. classic: the time left in the top half of the bar, the usage left in the bottom. lanes: the token lane on top, lit to the usage left, and the time lane below, lit to the par left; at the token lane's end, impacted cells amber to red for spend ahead of par and spare cells blue for spend behind it; the time lane deep red when more cells are impacted than the token lane has lit. gauge: the percent used in the badge, the bar the pace, filling left of a centre pipe under pace and right of it over pace. notch: the usage as one lane, a notch where the par is. A pace needs a reset time, a response of this session from the last 10 minutes, and a tenth of the window gone. classic (default) / lanes / gauge / notch

limit_7d_length.title: Cockpit: 7d bar › length (cells)
limit_7d_length.description: The number of cells the 7d limit's bar draws. A longer bar shows the same percentage in finer steps. The gauge style splits the length in half, one half to each side of the pipe, rounded down. (default: 7)

limit_5h_length.title: Cockpit: 5h bar › length (cells)
limit_5h_length.description: The number of cells the 5h limit's bar draws. A longer bar shows the same percentage in finer steps. The gauge style splits the length in half, one half to each side of the pipe, rounded down. (default: 10)

context_length.title: Cockpit: Context bar › length (cells)
context_length.description: The number of cells the context bar draws. A longer bar shows the same percentage in finer steps. The gauge style splits the length in half, one half to each side of the pipe, rounded down. (default: 10)

smart_zone.title: Cockpit: Smart zone on the context bar
smart_zone.description: The context bar's top half shows the smart zone left. Off, the bar shows only the context window left, in full-height blocks. true (default) / false

smart_zone_tokens.title: Cockpit: Smart zone (tokens)
smart_zone_tokens.description: The context size up to which recall stays precise; the context bar's top half shows how much of it is left. (default: 200000)

limit_forecast.title: Cockpit: Warn when a limit will run out before its reset
limit_forecast.description: The run-out warning in the explanation line, explain in the layout: shown when, at the pace this window has run at so far, the 7d or 5h limit reaches its target before it resets. A limit your account refused and a 5h paused while the 7d is used up do not warn. Off, the explanation line shows no warning. It needs a response of this session from the last 10 minutes, since a session hears the account's figure only in its own responses. true (default) / false

explain_row.title: Cockpit: Explanation line
explain_row.description: The explanation line, under the prompt by default, that holds the run-out warning. It takes a line even when it shows nothing, and a long warning wraps onto further lines. Off, it draws nothing. Also switched by dragging it in /cockpit:order. true (default) / false

turn_rate.title: Cockpit: Turn line › tokens per second
turn_rate.description: The tokens a turn generated per second, in the line that closes it (Cooked at 52 tok/s for 7s · done 11:22 PM). true (default) / false
